notes: Adds 20, 30 and 40-second question timer choices to Guardian character/team selection; defaults to 30. Numeric countdown appears above VS.
Time up damages the answering team like a wrong answer: Easy 50, Medium 100, Hard 150 HP. Applies once; a lethal timeout opens the opponent finisher and podium.

Clock stops on answer lock, pauses for Display/hidden app, and retains remaining time on Continue. Preserves artwork, Home, cutscenes, podium, controls and other modes. Exact ZIP SHA-256 and size match.
